points.description: States that the purpose of the desiccator is to cool the samples / bring down their temperature (to room temperature).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated (e.g. 'to keep samples safe') without clearly saying cooling.

points.description: States that cooling is done without moisture being picked up from the surroundings (no moisture addition/absorption from air, i.e. dry environment), so condensation or moisture gain is avoided.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'to keep dry' or mentions moisture/condensation vaguely without linking to the surroundings.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying the samples are cooled in the desiccator while avoiding moisture gain/condensation from the surrounding air. Give 1 mark if only cooling is stated, or only moisture protection is stated; part marks for vague wording. Give 0 for unrelated or wrong answers (e.g. to heat or to dry the sample further).
